title: Electrical and Electronic Systems
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Electrical and Electronic Systems Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate proficiency in technical skills and safety principles required for employment in the transportation and related industries performing electrical and electronic repair work.
Demonstrate their ability to assess, evaluate and solve problems common to electrical and electronic repair in the automotive, industrial, and agricultural industries.
Demonstrate a thorough understanding of the core material of electrical and electronic systems required for transfer to a four year university or certification in the department programs.

notes: The catalog prints codes without a space (AUTOB11, AUTOB30, AUTOB31). AUTOB11 and AUTOB30 are matched to closed-list AUTO B11 and AUTO B30.
The catalog titles AUTOB11 'Introduction to Automotive Technology', while the closed list titles AUTO B11 'Automotive Fundamentals'. A reviewer should confirm these are the same course.
AUTOB31 (Advanced Electrical and Electronic Systems, 4.5 units) is not in the closed list, so it is recorded as a catalog addition.
The 'Complete all of the following' heading is printed twice, nested. It is recorded as a single 'all' block.
The printed total of 12.5 units is on the program requirements header and is recorded as the certificate total. No separate block total is printed.
The description names workplaces (dealerships, independent repair shops, etc.) and ASE certification areas. These are not recorded as careers; only the 'Career Opportunities' job titles are recorded.
